Title: CyrenaKernelBuilder - Per-Chat Kernel Builder
Summary: Builder used to configure a Semantic Kernel instance for a specific chat conversation. Passed to modes and plugins during kernel initialization.
Content:
## CyrenaKernelBuilder

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Models`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Used to configure a new Semantic Kernel instance for a specific chat conversation. Passed to `IAssistantMode.ConfigureAsync` and `IAssistantPlugin.LoadAsync`.

### Constructor
```csharp
public CyrenaKernelBuilder(ChatConfiguration chatConfiguration, IKernelBuilder kernelBuilder)
```

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `ChatConfiguration` | `ChatConfiguration` | The chat being configured |
| `KernelBuilder` | `IKernelBuilder` | The underlying Semantic Kernel builder |
| `FeatureOptions` | `IDictionary<string, object>` | Per-kernel feature options |
| `Services` | `IServiceCollection` | Shortcut to `KernelBuilder.Services` |
| `Plugins` | `IKernelBuilderPlugins` | Shortcut to `KernelBuilder.Plugins` |

### Methods

#### AddFeatureOption<T>(T option)
Adds a named feature option to this kernel instance.

#### GetFeatureOption(string name)
Retrieves a feature option by name.

#### GetFeatureOption<T>()
Retrieves a feature option by type name.

### Usage in Plugin Loading
```csharp
public Task LoadAsync(CyrenaKernelBuilder builder)
{
    // Add Semantic Kernel plugin
    builder.Plugins.AddFromType<MyPlugin>();
    
    // Add kernel-scoped service
    builder.Services.AddSingleton<IMyService, MyService>();
    
    // Access feature options
    var prompts = builder.GetFeatureOption<IPromptManager>();
    prompts.AddPrompt(10, "System prompt text");
    
    return Task.CompletedTask;
}
```

### Related
- `IAssistantMode` - Receives this builder in ConfigureAsync
- `IAssistantPlugin` - Receives this builder in LoadAsync
- `ChatConfiguration` - The chat being configured
- `KernelController` - Creates and manages kernels using this builder
